name: Bloct v1.7.4
body:
## Changes

- Read the current Markdown file from disk with **⌘R** or right-click → **Reload**.
- Automatically refresh externally changed files in Read or Edit mode when there are no local edits.
- Preserve unsaved block edits and textarea input. Choose **Keep Editing**, **Discard Edits and Reload**, or **Save a Copy…** when versions conflict.
- Check the source before block editing and compare its bytes inside a coordinated save before writing. Preserve drafts and prevent stale saves or deleted-file recreation during discard/close.
- Follow document renames and retain existing context menus, preview security, relative images and blank-line block boundaries.

## Verification

- Native regression: 8 groups passed.
- WebKit: 15 passed; relative images: 70 passed.
- Hosted regression: 134 passed, 0 ordinary failures, 2 existing expected failures for initial overlapping loads (BUG_FIXES.md #20).
- Actual macOS GUI checks covered reload, conflict choices, save/cancel/discard, multiple documents, rename and deletion.
- Universal **Apple Silicon + Intel**, built with **macOS SDK 27.0**, minimum **macOS 14.0**.

The existing initial-load issue (#20) remains. Real Korean IME composition during external writes, deliberately delayed concurrent writes, network/iCloud volumes and execution on a physical macOS 14 device remain unverified. Detailed scope and evidence: [BUG_FIXES.md](https://github.com/JAEHYEON-BAE/bloct/blob/main/BUG_FIXES.md).

## Delivery

The published ZIP was downloaded and verified. Its SHA256 matches both the GitHub asset digest and the Homebrew 1.7.4 cask:

`ca115b98f3209ceea554e9b8edc5ab6f9f7f89e921c488091a600071177294f9`

[Full changelog](https://github.com/JAEHYEON-BAE/bloct/compare/v1.7.3...v1.7.4)
